sources.entry: lxml - A very fast, easy-to-use and versatile library for handling HTML and XML.

summary.one_liner: lxml is a Python library for processing XML and HTML, described by its README as feature-rich, easy to use, fast and memory friendly.
summary.what_it_does: The README is mostly a support and donation page, so it says little about the API itself. It describes lxml as a library for processing XML and HTML in Python. It points to external documentation (doc/main.txt) and an INSTALL.txt for the full introduction and installation steps. It states the library is distributed through the Python Package Index and in many Linux and macOS distributions. The rest covers sponsorship, a yearly income report, and a legal notice on donations. No specific parsing or query features are listed in the README text provided.
use_cases: parse and process XML documents in Python
parse and clean HTML pages in Python
fast XML handling where memory use matters
HTML manipulation as part of a scraping pipeline
notable: Described as very fast and memory friendly for XML and HTML processing
Distributed on PyPI and in many Linux and macOS package distributions
Development and CI supported by GitHub Actions, according to the README
caveats: The README provided does not include install or usage commands; they are in external INSTALL.txt and doc/main.txt files
Much of the README is donation and sponsorship content rather than technical detail
